title: Aider
description: Launch-time configuration for the Aider CLI.

fields.label: Aider config file
fields.description: Path to an aider YAML config file; passed as --config.

fields.label: API base URL
fields.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API; exported as OPENAI_API_BASE.

fields.label: API key secret name
fields.description: Name of a Domios secret holding the API key; its value is injected only into the launch environment as OPENAI_API_KEY.
